'''Head of manufacture''' was a title in the government of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the occupation of Balmorra by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an Imperial named [[Trabier]] held the position.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Our Points Of View|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>
